verdict.rationale: The full source is publicly hosted on GitHub and can be cloned directly (`git clone https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js.git`). A runtime probe of the npm registry verified the package is MIT-licensed, so the source is readable under a permissive open license. Missing for 10: no citation of the repository's own LICENSE file or first-party license documentation tying the MIT terms to the GitHub source tree itself.
